title: Removal from Service Special Powers Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Removal from Service Special Powers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
6th April, 2002]
F.No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated
6-4-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Removal from Service Special Powers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Article 13, P.O. No.5 of 1975

ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the removal from Service (Special Powers)
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
6th April, 2002]
F.No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated
6-4-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 9, Ordinance XVII of 2000.--In the said
Ordinance in section 10, for the full stop, at the end, a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely:--
"Provided
that where a representation or review petition has been preferred under section
9 but no decision has been received by or communicated to, the applicant or, as
the case may be, petitioner, within a period of sixty days of its submission to
the prescribed authority, he may prefer appeal to the Service Tribunal within
thirty days of the expiry of the aforesaid period."
